label: ZIP Code Error
meaning: An invalid ZIP Code was entered

label: ZIP Code Not Found
meaning: Submitted ZIP Code not found in Melissa Geocoder DB

label: Demo Mode (out of demo range)
meaning: GeoCoder Object in Demo Mode; out-of-demo ZIP detected

label: Data Files Expired
meaning: GeoCoder Object data files expired; update needed

label: Country Geocoding Disabled
meaning: Country geocoding disabled for current license

label: Postal Code Error / Unverified
meaning: Postal/ZIP code not found, invalid, or unverifiable

label: Unknown Street / Unverified
meaning: Street name not found in postal reference

label: Component Mismatch / Unverified
meaning: Address components mismatch the reference DB

label: Multiple Match (Ambiguous)
meaning: Address matched multiple records; tie unresolvable

label: PO/RR/HC Box Number Invalid
meaning: PO Box / Rural Route / Highway Contract box number invalid

label: PO/RR/HC Box Number Missing
meaning: PO Box / Rural Route / Highway Contract box number missing

label: CMRA Private Mail Box Missing
meaning: Commercial Mail Receiving Agency PMB number missing (US only)

label: Sub-Premise Not Required
meaning: Sub-premise entered but address has no secondaries
